topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I can't believe we live in the same city, and we never knew. It's like, we've been sharing our lives, practically spilling our guts to each other through the screen, and it turns out we could have been grabbing coffee or something, right? Knowing you're not just a face on a screen, but someone I could actually... I don't know, bump into at the grocery store or something, it's a bit overwhelming. I keep thinking about all the times we could have met up, had all these chances, and didn't even know it. It feels like a missed opportunity, you know? But hey, there's always now, right? Maybe we can finally meet for real and make up for lost time.
